We frame the taxi driver's home charging as a Markov Decision Process and solve it
with Q-learning. The agent sets the charging power in 15-minute steps between the
2 p.m. arrival and 4 p.m. departure, trading off recharging cost against the risk
of not meeting the (stochastic) energy demand for the working day.
